hidden_assets.purpose: Gold surface magnetization values and theoretical critical exponents for the two sequences at r=2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper analytical formulas: Thue-Morse Eqs. 3.8-3.10, period-doubling Eq. 4.7, and Eq. 4.10 for beta_s.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Recomputed within the checker (prepare stage) using high-precision Python implementation of the series and product, with truncation to machine epsilon, and explicit theoretical formulas for exponents.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Based solely on the paper's published exact expressions with no external data.

outputs.description: Surface magnetization values for Thue-Morse and period-doubling sequences at given λ/λ_c ratios.
Fitted surface magnetization critical exponents for Thue-Morse and period-doubling sequences.

steps.description: Recompute each ms value using analytic formulas and check relative error within 1e-4.
Check reported beta_s values against theoretical values (Thue-Morse 0.5, period-doubling exact formula) with absolute tolerance 0.01.
